name: Corte de Peleas (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, red and green in the proportions 4:1:1, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Corte de Peleas (a cross of Saint James, a bunch of grapes and a saint).
history: Municipal flag of Corte de Peleas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Corte de Peleas arms — cross of Saint James, grapes and saint
